auth.accepta_starea_curenta_a_conturilor: Accept the current state of the accounts (primary administrator)
auth.cont_nou_se_autentifica_numai: New account (signs in with card + PIN only)
auth.detectati_cardul_din_slot_alegeti: Detect the card in the slot, choose the certificate and enrol it (spare or replacement card). The card signs a challenge; the PIN is entered in the Windows / SafeNet window.
auth.incercari_gresite_de_parola_pana: Wrong password attempts before a temporary lock:
auth.incheie_sesiunea_si_inchide_aplicat: End the session and close the application
auth.inroleaza_cardul_ales_pentru_contul: Enrol the chosen card for my account
auth.inroleaza_cardul_ales_sectiunea_de: Enrol the chosen card (top section) for the selected account
auth.refuza_autentificarea_cand_nu_exist: Refuse sign-in when there is no current CRL (default: the classified edition refuses, the unclassified one warns)
auth.schimbarea_cere_parola_curenta_cel: Changing it requires the current password. At least 14 characters, different from the name, not a common password. The password stays valid even if you have a card enrolled.
auth.un_certificat_de_card_este: A card certificate is accepted only if it chains to a CA imported here. Revocation is read only from the imported CRLs (obtained offline); the application downloads nothing.
auth.utilizatorii_se_autentifica_cu_card: Users sign in with the card (contact smart card, in the keyboard slot) and PIN, managed by SafeNet Authentication Client. The application does not see the PIN. The primary administrator can also sign in at any time with account + password. Every action here goes into the hash-chained authentication audit.
card.arata_dovezile_constatarii_rezumat_: Shows the evidence of the finding: summary, list and technical details (SHA-256, parser, locator).
card.arata_observatia_dovezile_rationame: Shows the observation, the evidence, the reasoning, the limits and the check of this finding.
card.arata_pasii_recomandati_pentru_acea: Shows the recommended steps for this finding.
card.arata_verdictul_verificarii_automat: Shows the verdict of the automatic check for this finding and the controls it rests on.
card.detalii_tehnice_id_proba_sha: Technical details (evidence id, SHA-256, path, parser, locator)
card.explicatia_constatarii_ce_am_observ: Explanation of the finding: what we observed, evidence, reasoning, limits, check
card.lista_dovezilor_sursa_ora_descriere: List of evidence: source, time, description
card.no_next_step: No recommended step is recorded for this finding.
home.ce_doriti_sa_faceti: What would you like to do?
home.nicio_intrare_cazurile_deschise_de: No entries: cases opened from here appear in this list.
home.raspunsuri_calculate_din_cazul_desc: Answers computed from the open case: problems, severity, trust in the evidence, what was found and what comes next. Nothing here is typed by hand, and "nothing detected" does not mean "clean system".
inv.afiseaza_capetele_lanturilor_de_cust: Shows the ends of the custody and audit chains, to be written into the custody register with signature and date
inv.alegeti_o_constatare_din_lista: Choose a finding from the list: its card shows why it appeared, the evidence, the check and what to do. Selecting does not change anything in the case.
inv.colecteaza_de_pe_aceasta_statie: Collect from this station (logs, Prefetch, SRUM, live state)
inv.colecteaza_sau_importa_probele_le: Collects (or imports) the evidence, parses it, builds the timeline, correlates and reconstructs the incident chain. Everything is kept in a case with SHA-256 and a chain of custody.
inv.filtru_text_proces_cale_utilizator: Filter (text, process, path, user, IP, event ID):
inv.scopul_cazului_obligatoriu_de_ce: Case scope (required): why, for what period, on which systems, who approves
inv.separator_intre_lista_de_constatari: Separator between the findings list and the finding card
inv.zona_sistemului_analizat_pentru_comp: Zone of the analysed system (to compare with the media register):
ktd.basis_alternative: alternative explanation that cannot be excluded with the evidence in the case
ktd.basis_limit: limit of this kind of evidence or claim
ktd.basis_no_evidence: without evidence nothing can be claimed
ktd.ce_stim_ce_suspectam_si: What we know, what we suspect and what we cannot prove
ktd.no_evidence_claim: The finding “{0}” has no evidence attached
proc.inlocuieste_continutul_tabelului_la: replace the table content on import/paste
proc.program_de_lucru_mentenanta_jurnale: Working hours, log maintenance, approved software, expected GPO policy, zones and transfers. Entered by hand, pasted from a table or imported (JSON / CSV). The analysis compares them with what was observed; nothing is applied on Windows. An empty section is "undefined", never "compliant".
reg.date_introduse_manual_lipite_din: Data entered by hand, pasted from a table or imported (JSON / CSV). The analysis compares it with what was observed; nothing is applied on Windows. A register with no rows is "undefined register", never "compliant". Every saved change goes into an audit log chained by hash.
shell.izolare_automata_nu_este_disponibi: Automatic isolation: not available in the classified edition
shell.language.tip: Language of the texts in the application. It applies immediately and is remembered for this user; identifiers (rules, events, channels, files, hashes) are not translated.
shell.loganalyzer_enterprise_threat_tria: LogAnalyzer Enterprise — Threat Triage & Incident Response Command Center
shell.press_ctrl_k_for_command: Press Ctrl+K for command palette search across events, rules and artifacts
shell.starea_comutatorului_de_izolare_au: State of the automatic isolation switch. It is not an assessment of the safety of the station.
shell.statie_izolata_conectata_la_retea: ⚠ ISOLATED STATION CONNECTED TO THE NETWORK
shell.urmareste_jurnalele_windows_ale_st: Follows the Windows logs of the station (no kernel driver).
signin.card_smart_card_cu_contacte: Card (contact smart card, in the keyboard slot) + PIN
signin.introduceti_cardul_apasati_butonu: Insert the card, press the button and enter the PIN in the Windows / SafeNet window. The application does not see, store or record the PIN.
signin.numai_administratorul_principal_s: Only the primary administrator can sign in with a password, at any time, even when a card is enrolled. All other accounts use card and PIN only.
state.contradicted.meaning: There is evidence in the case that contradicts the finding.
state.correlated.meaning: Several observed facts match (in time, in path or in source); correlation does not prove causation.
state.inferred.meaning: It is an inference from observed facts, not a direct observation.
state.not_assessed.meaning: No check has assessed this finding yet.
state.observed.meaning: The fact appears directly in an item of evidence in the case.
state.supported.meaning: The check found evidence in the case that supports the finding.
state.unknown.meaning: It cannot be said with the evidence in the case.
state.unproven.meaning: The evidence in the case is not enough to demonstrate it.
state.verified.meaning: The automatic check confirmed the finding against the evidence in the case (it is not an external or human review).
term.amcache.explain: The list of applications known to Windows; an entry does not prove the application ran.
term.bam.explain: Windows record of the programs each user ran and the time of the last run.
term.chain_of_custody.explain: The record of who held the evidence, when, and what was done with it, with hashes that show whether it was changed.
term.correlation.explain: Events that occur together (in time, in path or in the same source); being close does not prove that one caused the other.
term.evidence_graph.explain: The map of links between files, processes, accounts, addresses and findings; each link shows its evidence or how it was derived.
term.evtx.explain: The files in which Windows records system, security and application events.
term.ioc.explain: An item (address, domain, file, hash) associated with malicious activity; seeing it does not prove an attack on its own.
term.prefetch.explain: The traces Windows keeps when a program is started: they show which program and roughly when, not who started it.
term.provenance.explain: The source of a piece of information: the evidence item, the file (with its SHA-256 hash) and the parser that produced it.
term.sigma.explain: A rule written in a common format that searches logs for patterns of suspicious activity.
term.verification.explain: The automatic check of each finding against the evidence in the case; it is not an external or human review.
term.yara.explain: A rule that searches files or content for patterns associated with malicious programs.
why.legacy_score: Old heuristic score: {0}/100, computed from: {1}. The score is not a check and does not replace the evidence above.
why.no_limits: No limit recorded (this does not mean there is none).
why.no_reasoning: The reason for the classification is not recorded for this finding.
